cds.text: Recognise that sentences are key units for expressing ideas
Understand that a simple sentence has a single independent clause representing one event or idea
Understand that compound sentences link two or more independent clauses, usually with a coordinating conjunction, to connect ideas
Recognise that sentences are groups of words working together to make meaning
Understand word classes: nouns (including pronouns), verbs, adjectives and adverbs, and what each represents
Understand that nouns can extend into noun groups with articles and adjectives, and verbs can form verb groups
Explore how images and words contribute to meaning in stories and informative texts
Compare how images in different text types contribute to meaning
Understand that images add to or multiply the meanings of a text
Recognise and develop awareness of vocabulary from familiar contexts, personal interests and school topics
Recognise the vocabulary of learning area topics
Experiment with and begin making conscious vocabulary choices to suit the topic
